result.finding: Two volumes configured in docker-compose.yml for the Oracle database service. The application container has no volume mounts as photo data is stored in Oracle DB as BLOBs. No VOLUME instruction in Dockerfile.
evidence: docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: named volume 'oracle_data' mounted at /opt/oracle/oradata for database persistence
docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: bind mount './oracle-init:/container-entrypoint-initdb.d' for initialization scripts
docker-compose.yml photoalbum-java-app service: no volumes configured (photos stored as BLOB in Oracle DB)
values: Application container: no persistent volumes (stateless, photos in Oracle BLOB)
